item.statement: Outside the valid domain the candidate has no required output; it must reject or explicitly exclude invalid geometry and must not synthesize an in-band odata status.

plans.objective: Confirm invalid-input handling is host-observable rejection or documented exclusion, with no odata status convention.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the validation/error paths.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff invalid geometry is rejected host-side or documented as outside contract, and no odata element is used as a status channel.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate host wrapper validation and kernel odata usage for width<=0, height<=0, and pitch<width.
